author: Good Enough
description:
Medieval hairstyles were far more unusual than most people realize. During the Middle Ages, certain haircuts were worn to show social status, profession, or religious devotion, while others became popular simply because of changing fashion. This Short explores some of the strangest medieval hairstyles that people actually wore centuries ago.

Discover the surprising hairstyles that were once completely normal during the Middle Ages.
title: These Medieval Haircuts Were Actually Real 💇‍♂️😲 #medieval #history #facts
